cells.gaps: Treasury said in October 2025 that procurement is still largely paper based, with a fully automated end-to-end tendering solution due by 2027/28 (ZAF-008), against the September 2026 deck listing eTenders functions through award (ZAF-006); end to end is not settled.
cells.note: National Treasury's September 2026 deck gives eTenders an average of 3,300 tenders and 1,800 awards a month (ZAF-007), a figure for e-procurement, with online bid submission (ZAF-005).
